get_experiment_config: get the default Jaxline experiment config for the PCQM4M-LSC graph neural network task
get_debug_config: get a smaller debug experiment config with reduced model size and fewer message passing steps
configure_model_hyperparameters: configure model hyperparameters like MLP hidden size, latent size, and message passing steps
configure_optimizer_schedule: configure the Adam optimizer with warmup and decay learning rate schedule for training
configure_dataset_options: configure dataset options including data root, k-fold splits, and conformer feature filtering
